definition: Fatty plaques that stiffen and narrow arteries, behind most heart attacks and strokes. Heart disease is a leading killer of Australian women too. Wear Red Day.
Sideways curve of the spine, often first noticed in the teens as one shoulder or hip sitting higher. Most cases are mild and just need watching.
Air leaking into the space around a lung so it partly collapses: sudden one-sided chest pain and breathlessness. Tall, thin young men and smokers are most at risk.
A fluid-filled cavity (syrinx) inside the spinal cord, often linked to a Chiari malformation. Classic sign: losing pain and temperature feeling across the shoulders in a ‘cape’ pattern.
